['Noweda Apothekergenossenschaft eG '].company_description: Noweda Apothekergenossenschaft eG operates as a central wholesaler for medicines and is a strong partner of local pharmacies. The company provides a comprehensive range of services and support for its member pharmacies, and it has a focus on digital solutions to facilitate the pharmacies' transition into the digital future. Noweda has been a key player in the pharmaceutical wholesale industry for over 80 years and is committed to providing same-day delivery services in collaboration with local pharmacies.

['Benteler Business Service GmbH'].company_description: Benteler Business Services GmbH operates in the automotive industry and provides metal, automotive engineering, and related services. The company was founded in 2010 and has a total of 33 patents.
